input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no exclusivity or sole-source obligation on Sparkling. The grant in § 2 is a non-exclusive licence to us; the use restrictions in § 3 are limited to copying, assignment, reverse engineering and protection of the Work, and the fees clause (§ 11) simply requires payment per the Fee Schedule. Searches for "exclusive", "sole", "requirements", "purchase" and competitor/third-party sourcing language return only non-exclusive licence grants, the exclusive-remedy provision in § 15, the non-exclusive escrow licence in § 16 and non-exclusive jurisdiction in the general terms — none of which restrict our freedom to procure software, maintenance or related services from other suppliers. Maintenance under § 10 is a renewable one-year term with no obligation to source support solely from Garman. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity binding the Customer), so no redline is required.
